puññatthika.p: [ puñña + atthika ] (ti) CL=10 One who desires merits.

R:
puññatthika：ပုညတ္ထိက （တိ） （ပုည+အတ္ထိက）
ကုသိုလ်ကောင်းမှုကို အလိုရှိသော။

puṇṇatā：ပုဏ္ဏ-တာ （ဣ）
ပြည့်သည်၏အဖြစ်။

puññattha.p: [ puñña + attha ] (pu) CL=10 (1) The benefit which is merits. (Ti) (2) One who has  merits as the benefit, One who searches for the merits.

puṇṇatthera.p: [ puṇṇa + thera ] (pu) CL=10 The elder called Puṇṇa. (1) The elder Puṇṇa who was the son of Mantāṇī. (2) The elder Puṇṇa who was a native of Sunāparanta region.
